ANTIMICROBIAL PROPHYLAXIS AFTER ERCP WITH INCOMPLETE DRAINAGE The risk of symptomatic infection is increased when drainage of the common bile duct is incomplete or if dye is trapped in the biliary tract.  In such cases, give antimicrobials for 5 days.

# 

Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h ($) R,DI < OR >

Amoxicillin-clavulante 875/125 mg PO q12h ($) R

#
